definitions.explanation: A hard pointed growth on the head of cattle, goats, etc.
The branched horn of a deer.

examples.japanese: {鹿|しか}の{角|つの}は{毎年|まいとし}{生|は}え{変|か}わる。

notes:
{角|つの} refers to animal horns.

NOTE ON READINGS:
- {角|つの}: horn (of animal)
- {角|かど}: corner (of street)
- {角|すみ}: corner (of room)

EXPRESSIONS:
- {角|つの}を{出|だ}す: to get angry (lit. to show one's horns)
- {角|つの}を{折|お}る: to give up one's stubbornness
